title: One checker-code declaration: checkers/<name>/checker.yaml (format v3)
description: A declaration makes an artifact of checker code known by name and publisher, so a consumer's tools load nothing the rulebook did not declare (S23, S3). It is no trust: nothing reads, loads or runs the code, and the digest is the release's. What the schema cannot say without a conditional, the reader holds on the parsed document: the name equal to the folder, and an own artifact's tests

name.description: the artifact's name, equal to its folder under checkers/

tool.description: the tool whose plugin, analyzer, pattern rule or policy the artifact is

tests.description: the artifact's own tests, relative to its folder; the rulebook's own artifact has them

from.description: the rulebook name of the import whose artifact this declares by reference; absent for the rulebook's own

relative.description: a slash-separated path below the artifact's folder: no leading slash, no drive, no backslash, no step that is . or ..
